title: Chemical Parliaments and Microbial Cheaters: Quorum Sensing and Sociomicrobiology vs. Diffusion and Efficiency Sensing — From Nealson, Platt & Hastings's 1970 Vibrio fischeri autoinduction burst to Miller & Bassler's intra-species AHL/oligopeptide dialects and inter-species AI-2 Esperanto; Diggle & West's Hamiltonian kin-selection proof of lasR cheater invasion in Pseudomonas aeruginosa & Wang and Greenberg's RhlR cyanide metabolic policing; Redfield's solitary phagosome/micropore diffusion-sensing critique & Hense's unified efficiency-sensing reaction-diffusion physics

teenKit.tldr: Bacteria don't have brains, yet they vote as a crowd using chemical signals to coordinate massive group behaviors like glowing or launching lethal infections. Rival theories argue they are actually just measuring local fluid flow to avoid wasting precious energy in empty spaces.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how microbes communicate and police cheaters lets us design revolutionary new anti-bacterial drugs that disarm lethal infections by jamming their radio signals instead of trying to poison them with traditional antibiotics.
keyTakeaways: Vibrio fischeri bacteria burn 20% of their cellular energy to glow, so they turn their lights off when alone in the open ocean and only light up when crowded inside a squid's light organ.

Quorum sensing acts as a biological parliament where Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria use chemical dialects like homoserine lactones and oligopeptides to take a demographic census of their neighbors.

Invasions of social cheaters—mutants that take the benefits of group toxins without paying the metabolic cost—force populations to evolve metabolic policing mechanisms like hydrogen cyanide to punish defectors.

vocab.meaning: A system where bacteria release and detect chemical signaling molecules to coordinate group behavior based on population density.
The rival counter-hypothesis that chemical signals measure local fluid drainage and physical confinement rather than neighbor population counts.
An evolutionary framework proving that cooperative traits can survive if individuals help their close genetic relatives pass on shared genes.
A unified physical model blending reaction-diffusion equations to show cells optimize chemical retention relative to local fluid flow.

quiz.question: Why do Vibrio fischeri bacteria instantly shut off their bioluminescence when they are dumped from a squid into the open ocean?
options: The ocean water is too cold for chemical reactions
Glowing alone in the open water costs 20% of their cellular energy with zero benefit, making it evolutionary suicide
Sunlight instantly destroys the luciferase enzymes required for light production
Predatory fish consume the chemical signals as a food source
quiz.explanation: Emitting photons costs an astronomical 10% to 20% of cellular ATP, so glowing while floating alone in the empty ocean is a massive metabolic waste.

quiz.question: What is the core argument of Rosemary Redfield's 'Diffusion Sensing' counter-hypothesis?
options: Bacteria communicate exclusively using electrical impulses instead of chemical molecules
Chemical accumulation is actually a tool for measuring local physical confinement and diffusion rates rather than counting neighbor cell numbers
Infections are controlled entirely by host immune systems rather than bacterial density
Microbes never cooperate and only act as completely solitary agents
quiz.explanation: Redfield argued that a single isolated bacterium trapped in a tight space can trigger full autoinduction because its self-produced molecules cannot diffuse away.

quiz.question: How do Pseudomonas aeruginosa populations deal with 'social cheaters' that refuse to pay the metabolic cost of making cooperative toxins?
options: They physically expel them from the biofilm using specialized motor proteins
They starve them by locking down all regional iron supplies
They utilize coupled metabolic policing systems like RhlR-driven hydrogen cyanide production to target and eliminate defectors
They ignore them because cheaters have no impact on overall group survival
quiz.explanation: Cells link cooperative public good production directly to essential metabolic pathways, meaning cheaters that don't contribute are metabolically policed and killed.
